snippet.title: Ablahshikar - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A turn-based salvage-survival CRPG adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal, tear organs from rival warships to rebuild your vessel into a doomed chimera—then make landfall in the archaic city of Dastgerd to pawn borrowed life, trade heretical folios, and barter across silk and oaths.

-
🖤 A Solo Project by Samekh Meryuiet (Amurdat Phantasmatoria)
🔊 Audio & Narrative Design by Briar Soundworks
🎙️ Voice Performances:
• Seamus Bryner
• Caitlin Williams
• Samekh Meryuiet (Vocal SFX & OST Vocals)

🎮 Wishlist Ablahshikar on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952800/Ablahshikar/
